title: Faithfully flat descent of Noetherianity for E∞-rings
statement_scope: Whole Lemma 1.5.6: let f: A → B be a faithfully flat map of E∞-rings. If B is Noetherian, then A is Noetherian, where Noetherian means A is connective, π0A is a Noetherian commutative ring, and each πnA is a finitely generated module over π0A (as recalled on author PDF p. 23).

context_spans.label: Noetherian E∞-ring convention and Definition 1.5.4 (locally Noetherian)

standard_prerequisites: Definition of a Noetherian E∞-ring (author PDF p. 23): connective, π0A Noetherian, and each πnA finitely generated over π0A.
Faithful flatness, exactness of tensor products, and the elementary ideal-injection argument for faithful flat ring extensions.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because the proof at author PDF p. 24 carries a concrete non-routine descent argument: it first proves π0A Noetherian by injecting ideals I of π0A into ideals Iπ0B of π0B, using the exact sequence 0 → I∩J → I⊕J → I+J → 0 and faithful flatness to recover equality from equality after tensoring; it then proves A connective and each πnA finitely generated by choosing a finitely generated submodule M with M⊗π0Aπ0B → πnB surjective and using faithful flatness of π0B over π0A to force the cokernel to vanish. This is more than a standard one-line citation, but it is a supporting Noetherian-descent lemma rather than an H3 construction.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Faithful-flat ideal injection for π0A, exact sequence for intersections and sums, and finite generation descent for each πnA via faithful flatness of π0B over π0A.
